name: Chole Chat
procedure: Soak 100g black chana overnight.
Put soaked chana in pressure cooker 4 whistles on high and 3 on low.
Chop 100g onion and 70g Tomato in chopper.
After Chana is prepared mix with vegetables and add salt,spice and chat masala according to taste.
Bonus: Squeeze lemon on top.

name: White Sauce Pasta
procedure: Soak 100g Pasta with some salt in a pot and cook properly.
Simultaneously, add 20g butter in a pan and melt it.
On low heat, add 20g maida into melted butter.
On high heat, add 250g milk in 3 portions(to avoid lumps).
On low heat, add some salt and pasta seasoning.
On low heat, add cheese and mix until cheese is melted.

name: Schezwan Cheese Sandwich
procedure: Spread a cheese slice on each slice of bread.
Add 10g of schezwan to each sandwich.
Put in sandwicher.

name: Subway Sandwich
procedure: Put bread on sandwicher.
Put one slice of cheese slice.
Put 25g of iceberg lettuce.
Put circular slices of onions and tomatoes.
Put 50g paneer.
Add sauces.
Put second cheese slice.
Put bread and cook till bread turns slightly brown.

name: Pulao
procedure: Wash 100g Rice.
Chop potatos and onions in long slices.
Add 15g Ghee in a pot and add potatos and onions.
Added washed rice.
Add salt, red chili and haldi into the pot.
Cook for 10-15 minutes.

name: Paneer Pulao
procedure: Wash 100g Rice.
Chop potatos and onions in long slices.
Add 15g Ghee in a pot and add potatos and onions.
Added washed rice.
Add salt, red chili and haldi into the pot.
Cook for 10-15 minutes.
Add 100g Paneer after pulao is finished.

name: Schezwan Fried Rice
procedure: Wash rice and prepare rice
Chop all the vegetables using chopper
Place oil in pan and add vegetables and saute
Bonus: Squeeze lemon on top.
Add cooked rice into pan.
Add schezwan masala into pan and mix

name: Paneer Schezwan Fried Rice
procedure: Wash rice and prepare rice
Chop all the vegetables using chopper
Place oil in pan and add vegetables and saute
Bonus: Squeeze lemon on top.
Add cooked rice into pan.
Add schezwan masala into pan and mix
Add 100g Paneer after pulao is finished.

name: Rajma Chawal
procedure: Soak 100g Rajma(For atleast 4 hours).
Put soaked rajma with salt in pressure cooker 4 whistles on high and 3 on low.
Simultaneously, wash 100g rice, and cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes.
Simultaneously, put tomatoes and onions with red chilli, salt and haldi into mixer and blend.
Cook the blend on a pan with rajma masala until blend is dehydrated.
After rajma is prepared, add it with rajma water into blend and mix properly

name: Aloo Matar with Paratha
procedure: Put potatoes in microwave with water for 15 minutes.
Peal the boiled potatoes and mash them.
Put ghee in pan and heat with haldi, salt and red chili.
Add mashed potatoes into ghee mixture.
Cook paratha.
